stories.title: Japan opposition alliance on brink of collapse after merger talks stall
stories.summary: Japan’s centrist opposition alliance stood on the brink of falling apart on Monday, with sources saying members who joined from the Komeito party just months ago could leave the group. The development follows the collapse of talks on the incorporation by the Centrist Reform Alliance of members of Komeito and the Constitutional Democratic Party of Japan (CDPJ) in a three-way merger to counter the ruling coalition, led by Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi. stories.title: Hanwha Aerospace signs deal to export K9 howitzers to Spain
stories.summary: South Korean defense company Hanwha Aerospace Co. said Monday it has signed a deal with Spanish defense firm Indra Sistemas S.A. to export K9 self-propelled howitzers. In a regulatory filing, Hanwha Aerospace said it signed the contract with Indra without disclosing the contract value or delivery schedule, citing confidentiality. Under the contract, Hanwha Aerospace will receive an initial payment equivalent to 20 percent of the contract value after signing, followed by another 5 percent by the end of the year. The deal marks the first entry of Hanwha Aerospace's K9 into the Western European market, which would bring the number of countries operating the self-propelled howitzer to 11.
